checks.name: focused synthetic controls and host child watchdog
checks.scope: Synthetic JSONB-text snapshots and an actual short-lived host Node child waiting for stdin; no PostgreSQL, Docker, HTTP or runtime operation.

historicalChecks.scope: Earlier same-suite invocation before final I/O durability and README changes; not the final frozen source check.

independentReview.method: Source-only review; reviewer ran no tests, PostgreSQL, Docker, HTTP or runtime operations.
resolvedSourceFindings: PostgreSQL ORDER BY now repeats the primary-key expression before COLLATE C; no invalid output-alias-in-expression lookup.
Validator key ordering now uses UTF-8 byte order consistent with SQL C collation and storage ordering, including BMP/astral synthetic coverage.
Owned-auth comparison pins exact safe metadata for target, backup, IDs, load, expiries and cookie-secret SHA while retaining every old auth row byte-exact.
closingDelta: Best-effort storage iterator destruction no longer prevents PostgreSQL close.
Host capture records transport error and waits for child close before retaining the final raw output.
Baseline and comparison-input references are durably retained before comparison classification.
Start/end source hashes fence the audit implementation and shared binding.
Added README with exact comparison modes, limits, durability and proof boundaries.

intendedActualComparison.businessRepresentation: Exact PostgreSQL JSONB text preserved as strings for hashing and comparison; JavaScript parsing is only a syntax/schema check.
intendedActualComparison.storageProof: Key, raw size, ETag, lastModified and metadata only; raw model/artifact SHA is delegated to separately executed backup/restore inventory checks.
intendedActualComparison.ownedAuthInput: Hash-pinned closed-schema allowed-auth.private.json safe metadata; never a bearer token or cookie.

acceptance: Source controls only. No operational recovery, engineering, native parity or human acceptance is inferred.
